version: 0.4.0
kind: schema
schema_type: meta

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.schema
  name: schema.schema
  description: Meta-schema that defines the shape, naming, and field rules for Prismata schema documents.

spec:
  target_kind: schema
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true
  imports: []
  rules:
    - name: udi-required
      description: All schemas must define a metadata.udi field.
    - name: kind-required
      description: All schemas must declare a top-level kind.
    - name: version-required
      description: All schemas must declare a top-level version.
    - name: name-required
      description: All schemas must declare metadata.name.
    - name: required-fields-present
      description: All fields listed in required_fields must exist in the final object.
    - name: path-valid
      description: All field paths must map to valid YAML object locations.

required_fields:
  - name: version
    path: version
    type: string
    description: Semantic version of the schema document.

  - name: kind
    path: kind
    type: string
    description: Must be "schema" for all schema-definition documents.

  - name: schema_type
    path: schema_type
    type: string
    description: Secondary classifier describing the type of schema (meta, shared, object, ui, composition, plan).

  - name: metadata.udi
    path: metadata.udi
    type: string
    description: Universal Deterministic Identifier for this schema.

  - name: metadata.name
    path: metadata.name
    type: string
    description: Human-readable name of the schema.

  - name: metadata.description
    path: metadata.description
    type: string
    description: Description of what this schema defines.

  - name: spec.target_kind
    path: spec.target_kind
    type: string
    description: The canonical kind of artifact this schema validates.

  - name: spec.naming.file_suffix
    path: spec.naming.file_suffix
    type: string
    description: Required filename suffix for schema documents.

  - name: spec.versioning.semver
    path: spec.versioning.semver
    type: boolean
    description: Whether semantic versioning is required.

optional_fields:
  - name: spec.imports
    path: spec.imports
    type: array
    description: Shared schemas imported by this schema.

  - name: spec.rules
    path: spec.rules
    type: array
    description: Validation rules applied to schema documents.

  - name: fields
    path: fields
    type: array
    description: Field definitions for this schema.

  - name: object
    path: object
    type: object
    description: Canonical shape of objects validated by this schema.

  - name: properties
    path: properties
    type: object
    description: Semantic meaning of object fields.

fields:
  - name: version
    path: version
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Semantic version of the schema document.

  - name: kind
    path: kind
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Must be "schema" for all schema-definition documents.

  - name: schema_type
    path: schema_type
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Secondary classifier describing the type of schema.

  - name: metadata
    path: metadata
    type: object
    required: true
    description: Metadata describing the schema itself.

  - name: metadata.udi
    path: metadata.udi
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Universal Deterministic Identifier for this schema.

  - name: metadata.name
    path: metadata.name
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Human-readable name of the schema.

  - name: metadata.description
    path: metadata.description
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Description of what this schema defines.

  - name: spec
    path: spec
    type: object
    required: true
    description: Specification block defining schema behavior.

  - name: spec.target_kind
    path: spec.target_kind
    type: string
    required: true
    description: The canonical kind of artifact this schema validates.

  - name: spec.naming.file_suffix
    path: spec.naming.file_suffix
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Required filename suffix for schema documents.

  - name: spec.versioning.semver
    path: spec.versioning.semver
    type: boolean
    required: true
    description: Whether semantic versioning is required.

  - name: spec.imports
    path: spec.imports
    type: array
    required: false
    description: Shared schemas imported by this schema.

  - name: spec.rules
    path: spec.rules
    type: array
    required: false
    description: Validation rules applied to schema documents.

  - name: fields
    path: fields
    type: array
    required: false
    description: Field definitions for this schema.

  - name: object
    path: object
    type: object
    required: false
    description: Canonical shape of objects validated by this schema.

  - name: properties
    path: properties
    type: object
    required: false
    description: Semantic meaning of object fields.

object:
  version: ""
  kind: ""
  schema_type: ""
  metadata:
    udi: ""
    name: ""
    description: ""
  spec:
    target_kind: ""
    naming:
      file_suffix: ""
    versioning:
      semver: true
    imports: []
    rules: []
  fields: []
  properties: {}

properties:
  version:
    meaning: "Semantic version of the schema document."
  kind:
    meaning: "UDI kind of this schema."
  schema_type:
    meaning: "Secondary classifier describing the type of schema."
  metadata.udi:
    meaning: "Universal Deterministic Identifier for this schema."
  metadata.name:
    meaning: "Human-readable name of the schema."
  metadata.description:
    meaning: "Description of what this schema defines."
  spec.target_kind:
    meaning: "The canonical kind of artifact this schema validates."
  spec.naming.file_suffix:
    meaning: "Required filename suffix for schema documents."
  spec.versioning.semver:
    meaning: "Whether semantic versioning is required."
  spec.imports:
    meaning: "Shared schemas imported by this schema."
  spec.rules:
    meaning: "Validation rules applied to schema documents."
  fields:
    meaning: "Field definitions for this schema."
  object:
    meaning: "Canonical shape of objects validated by this schema."
  properties:
    meaning: "Semantic meaning of object fields."
